5302.title: Recording export in the native shell
5302.rootCauseOneLine: Failed-audio export only clicks a blob download anchor; there is no native file handoff. Same-origin blob navigation is allowed on root mounts, so the reported universal navigation rejection is not the cause.
5302.proposedFix: First instrument the native iOS WebView download delegate with synthetic audio. Then implement a bounded, capability-negotiated file export with native temporary-file cleanup, completion/error feedback, and retention on failure; do not merely allow more URL schemes.
5302.caveats: Source-level partial reproduction only; no iOS hardware reproduction. Same-origin root-mounted blob navigation is allowed. The second clean forced run supports these limited findings, not a device-level success or failure.
